description.value: NOMAD Cider is a farm-to-glass craft cidery producing a wide range of styles — from foundation and orchard series to barrel-aged and internationally inspired ciders — made exclusively from fresh-pressed local Okanagan-Similkameen apples and pears. The operation includes a Tasting Room and Cider House at its Simpson Road location, making it a natural stop for cyclists exploring the Summerland and Naramata bench country. Their lineup spans dozens of distinct ciders, including ice cider and keeved expressions that reflect serious traditional craft.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms NOMAD Cider is an active craft cidery with a tasting room and cider house at 8011 Simpson Rd, Summerland, BC, providing phone (250.469.6601) and email (info@nomadcider.ca). The OSM community tag says 'Naramata' but the website clearly states 'Summerland, British Columbia V0H 1Z2' — a discrepancy flagged below. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the website; the online shop shows a pickup option, supporting Takeout as true.
